From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@nr-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Northridge Analytics: technical impact spotlight — planning & recording consent

Hi Amira / Carlos,

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with us about the recent deployment you ran with Redwood. We’d love to put together a short technical impact spotlight that highlights the latency/cost improvements and how your engineering team integrated prefix caching and batching — purely for a customer case study and a short one-page outcomes summary.

High-level ask: a 45-minute discovery interview with an engineer + a product owner to capture technical decisions, metrics, and a few screenshots of dashboards. We record these sessions (audio + video) for transcription and to expedite quotes; we will share the transcript and a short draft for your review before anything goes public. Please let us know if that recording is OK.

Proposed agenda (attached: redwood_case_agenda_v1.docx):
- 5m introductions + purpose
- 15m technical architecture & rollout timeline (engineers)
- 15m quantitative outcomes: latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens, before/after
- 10m customer results & quote capture + next steps

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 3, 10:00–10:45
- Tue Nov 3, 14:00–14:45
- Wed Nov 4, 11:00–11:45

If those don’t work, happy to take times you propose. Also helpful to confirm who will join from your side (names + roles) and any compliance folks we should loop in for permissions.

Thanks — appreciate your time.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Customer Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood_case_agenda_v1.docx (agenda, 1 page)

- Carlos Mendez (Engineering Lead)
- Amira Hassan (Head of Data Products)
